name: Intralesional interferon α-2b
question: Does intralesional interferon α-2b improve penile deformity and symptoms more than saline injections in men with Peyronie's disease?

design.population: Men with Peyronie's disease of at least 12 months' duration, a single plaque, erect curvature of at least 30°, and no calcified plaque, enrolled at eight centers (mean age 55.1 years).
design.description: Multicenter, single-blind, placebo-controlled parallel study; allocation method not reported
design.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 395

verdictNote: No prespecified primary endpoint; curvature, plaque measures, and pain favored interferon.
takeaway: Among 103 completers in a single-blind placebo-controlled study, six interferon α-2b injections improved curvature, plaque size and density, and pain more than saline; the between-group erectile-function difference was not significant.

reports.label: Penile Doppler analysis
reports.citation: Kendirci M, Usta MF, Matern RV, Nowfar S, Sikka SC, Hellstrom WJ. "The impact of intralesional interferon alpha-2b injection therapy on penile hemodynamics in men with Peyronie's disease." *J Sex Med.* 2005;2(5):709-715. doi:10.1111/j.1743-6109.2005.00110.x
reports.followUp: After six injections administered every other week
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 711

results.measure: Mean cavernosal peak systolic velocity (cm/s ± SEM) before and at least 4 weeks after six injections in the 39-patient Doppler analysis
results.note: Within-arm P<0.05 for interferon and P>0.05 for saline; the paper gives no numerical between-group P value or confidence interval for PSV.
results.locator: Full text, Table 4 and Results, p 712

results.measure: Patients with nonvascular status (PSV >30 cm/s, EDV ≤5 cm/s, and RI >0.8) before and after treatment in the 39-patient Doppler analysis
results.note: Within-arm P<0.05 for interferon and P>0.05 for saline. The published percentages do not match one-decimal rounding from the reported counts; counts are retained.
results.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 711; Table 5 and Results, p 712

results.measure: Mean penile duplex resistive index and end-diastolic velocity (cm/s), before and after treatment
results.note: P values are within-arm comparisons; no confidence interval or exact between-group P value is reported.
results.locator: Full text, Table 4 and Results, p 712

results.measure: Patients with borderline arterial insufficiency before and after treatment by penile duplex
Mean IIEF erectile-function score (maximum 30) before and after treatment; paired questionnaires returned by 17/19 interferon and 16/20 saline recipients
results.note: Table 3 headings give arm n=19 and n=20, but the Results state that 17 and 16, respectively, completed paired questionnaires; the score analysis denominators are not explicit.
results.locator: Full text, Table 3, p 711; Results, p 712

harms.label: Sinusitis, flu-like symptoms, and penile swelling with ecchymosis

values.exp: Reported; event count not given for the 19-patient interferon group
values.ctl: 2/20 reported minor penile swelling with ecchymosis

harms.note: The report describes flu-like symptoms as fever, chills, and arthralgia; symptoms responded to over-the-counter NSAIDs and lasted no more than 24–48 hours. It states adverse effects occur in up to 40% without a subset numerator. No Clavien-Dindo grading is given.

delivery.label: Doppler analysis subset and regimen

values.exp: 19 patients; 5 million units interferon α-2b in 10 mL saline every other week for six injections over 12 weeks
values.ctl: 20 patients; 10 mL saline every other week for six injections

delivery.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, pp 710–711

delivery.label: Injection and Doppler assessment technique
delivery.value: Circumferential penile block with 1% lidocaine without epinephrine approximately 10 minutes before plaque injection; 10 mL syringe and 27-gauge needle with multiple punctures; direct pressure at least 2 minutes after injection. PDDU used intracavernosal prostaglandin E1 and audiovisual stimulation and was repeated at least 4 weeks after injection six.
delivery.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 711

harms.label: Sinusitis, flu-like symptoms, and minor penile swelling with ecchymosis

values.exp: Reported frequently; event counts not provided

harms.note: Flu-like symptoms included fever, chills, and arthralgia; all described symptoms responded to over-the-counter NSAIDs taken before injection and lasted no longer than 36 hours. No Clavien-Dindo grades reported.

harms.label: Withdrawal due to injection complications
harms.note: None of the 14 withdrawals was attributed to injection complications.

delivery.value: Plaque injected with a 10 mL syringe and 25-gauge needle using the multiple-puncture technique; erect curvature measured by protractor, plaque area by handheld calipers, and plaque density by patient questionnaire (0–3); outcomes assessed at least 4 weeks after injection six.
